home.title: Sugar palm fruit, graded and packed for the container.
home.subtitle: We consolidate kolang-kaling from two partner harvest areas, boil and grade it under one standard, and ship it in full 20-foot loads under your packing specification.
home.heroNote: Minimum order 1 × 20ft FCL · Free 1 kg sample
home.aboutBody: Kolang-kaling is the immature endosperm of the sugar palm, sold in Southeast Asia as attap chee and used in desserts, canned fruit cocktails, and beverages. It arrives boiled and held in brine or light syrup, translucent and firm, ready for your own processing line.

one.title: One party accountable
one.body: You contract with us, not with a village collector. Quality claims, replacement, and documents stay with a single counterparty from PO to bill of lading.

two.title: Graded before it is packed
two.body: Fruit is sorted by diameter and rejected for browning before boiling, so a container does not average out to your minimum grade.

three.title: Two harvest areas, one standard
three.body: Harvest seasons in Sukabumi and Lebak overlap but do not coincide, which keeps supply steadier across the year than a single-village source.

home.productTeaserBody: Two grades, three packing formats, and a spec sheet you can hand to your QC team before you commit to a sample.
home.ctaTitle: Tell us your destination port and volume.
home.ctaBody: Send the grade, monthly volume, and packing you need. You will get an indicative price and a packing photo set back — usually the same working day.
home.originBody: Sugar palm is not planted in blocks like oil palm. It grows scattered across smallholder land on hill slopes, which is why consolidation — not plantation size — is what determines whether an export volume can actually be filled.

product.title: Product specification
product.intro: Figures below are our standard offer. Size band, preserving medium, and packing can be adjusted to your specification on contract volumes.

gradeA.name: Grade A
gradeA.body: Whole, uniform, translucent white. For canning, dessert toppings, and retail packs where the fruit is visible.

gradeB.name: Grade B
gradeB.body: Mixed size, minor cosmetic variation. For fillings, beverage bases, and further processing where appearance is not critical.

drum50.name: HDPE drum, 50 kg
drum50.body: Food-grade drum with double liner. The usual choice for buyers who reprocess on arrival.

drum100.name: HDPE drum, 100 kg
drum100.body: Lowest cost per kilo. Suited to industrial lines that decant in bulk.

vacuum.name: Vacuum bag, 1 / 5 / 10 kg
vacuum.body: Portioned and ready for cold storage. Chosen for retail packing and trial shipments.

product.customNote: Need a different size band, preserving medium, or private label packing? Send the specification and we will quote against it directly.

appearance.name: Appearance
appearance.body: Whole elliptical seeds, clean and glossy, free of husk fibre.

color.name: Colour
color.body: Natural translucent white. No chlorine or synthetic bleaching agent at any stage.

texture.name: Texture
texture.body: Firm and resilient bite — not soft, not slimy.

odor.name: Odour
odor.body: Fresh sugar palm, neutral. No fermented sourness and no chemical smell.

evidence.title: Measured, not claimed
evidence.intro: Every dimension below was photographed against a millimetre rule. Buyers do not trust the words “Grade A”; they trust the ruler lying next to the seed.
evidence.weighing: 100 kg batch verified on a calibrated scale

tds.title: Technical data sheet
tds.body: The full bilingual TDS as a PDF — hand it to your QC team before you ask for a sample.

supply.title: Supply network
supply.intro: We buy from two partner harvest areas in West Java and Banten and process to a single standard before packing. We do not publish partner names — that is a commercial decision, and we are happy to disclose them under an NDA once a contract is in progress.
supply.qcIntro: Five checkpoints between the tree and the container. Each one is a point where a lot can be rejected, not merely graded down.

sorting.name: Incoming sorting
sorting.body: Fruit arriving from collectors is inspected for maturity and browning. Over-ripe lots are rejected at intake, not blended in.

boiling.name: Boiling and soaking
boiling.body: Boiled to remove the irritant sap, then soaked and washed in changes of water until the residual astringency is gone.

grading.name: Diameter grading
grading.body: Separated into Grade A and Grade B by size, so each container matches the grade on the contract.

packing.name: Brining and packing
packing.body: Filled, brine or syrup added to specification, sealed, and coded with the lot number that follows it onto the packing list.

inspection.name: Pre-shipment inspection
inspection.body: Buyer or third-party inspection (SGS, Sucofindo) can be arranged before stuffing, at buyer's cost.

supply.traceBody: Every pail carries a lot code that identifies the harvest area and the boiling batch. If a claim is raised, the affected lot can be isolated instead of the whole shipment.

videos.title: See the facility
videos.intro: Two short clips, unedited: the collection warehouse with its sorting tables and soaking tubs, and a macro look at the fruit itself.
videos.warehouse: Warehouse, sorting tables, and soaking tubs

process.title: How an order runs
process.intro: From first enquiry to bill of lading, this is the sequence and roughly what each step costs in time.

one.name: Enquiry
one.body: You send grade, volume, packing, and destination port. We return an indicative price, normally within one working day.

two.name: Sample
two.body: A 1 kg sample ships free of charge; you cover the courier. Larger evaluation samples are quoted separately.

three.name: Contract and PI
three.body: We issue a proforma invoice with the agreed specification, Incoterm, and payment terms. Advance payment starts production.

four.name: Production
four.body: Fruit is collected, boiled, graded, and packed against your lot. This is the step that sets the lead time.

five.name: Inspection and stuffing
five.body: Optional third-party inspection, then the container is stuffed and sealed at the processing site.

six.name: Documents
six.body: Invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, phytosanitary and health certificates are issued and sent by courier and email.

seven.name: Shipment
seven.body: Loaded at Tanjung Priok. Transit time depends on your port and carrier.

process.docsNote: Certificates required by your country's import authority differ. Tell us the destination and we will confirm what can be issued before you place the order.

contact.title: Request a quotation
contact.intro: Fill in what you know. Fields you leave blank are fine — we will ask. The form opens WhatsApp with your details already written out, so nothing is retyped.

form.name: Your name
form.errorRequired: Please fill in at least your name and either an email or a phone number.

contact.responseNote: Enquiries received before 15:00 Jakarta time are usually answered the same day.

footer.tagline: Sugar palm fruit from West Java and Banten, consolidated and shipped by the container.
